description: Experimental taxonomy-only ensemble for complete 8-15mer peptides, stacked from composition, residue-CNN, and Transformer models.
output_semantics: Independent sigmoid probabilities of exact SwissProt category membership; categories may overlap and do not sum to one.

training.labels: taxonomy membership only; no MHC, neoantigen, or T-cell-response labels
training.split: 70/15/15 by protein mnemonic family; exact peptides crossing folds removed
training.stack_fit: per-category logistic regression on validation-family member logits plus peptide length

held_out_evaluation.note: The untouched test fold was scored once after member and stack selection. This remains a weak taxonomy signal, not an immunogenicity predictor.
